name: ToolGen Incorporated
summary: ToolGen Incorporated is a biotechnology enterprise based in South Korea, primarily focused on pioneering advancements in genome editing technology. The company's main endeavor involves engineering CRISPR-Cas9 genetic modification tools specifically designed for editing genes in eukaryotic cells. Furthermore, its operations extend to commercializing its intellectual property, exploring therapeutic applications, and participating in the seed sector. Established in 1999, ToolGen's corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea.
